title: Splitting a run
statement: Let $M$ be a multi-tape Turing machine, let $c$ be a configuration on a fixed input, and let $a,b\in\mathbb{N}$. Running $M$ for $a+b$ steps from $c$ gives the same configuration as running it for $b$ steps from the configuration reached after $a$ steps from $c$.
hypotheses_covered: A configuration on a fixed input
replaced:
For every multi-tape Turing machine $M$, configuration $c$, and
$a, b \in \mathbb{N}$, running $M$ for $a + b$ steps from $c$ equals running
$M$ for $b$ steps from the configuration reached after $a$ steps from $c$.
